name: [🔨] Build a Scam Empire!
desc:
💬 Welcome to Build a Scam Empire! 💻📱

Buy scammers, place them on your plot, and watch HOW MUCH MONEY THEY MAKE YOU!

HOW TO PLAY:

📞 Buy scammers from the shop
☎️ Place them on your plot so they can start calling & scamming
💳 Collect cards
🔁 Sell & REPEAT!

Remember, your empire literally earns while you are offline ⭐
